name: @cyclone-ui/test-results
description: TestResults, a test run by an AI agent, built on Trace: a summary line that counts the tests ("Ran 42 tests, 2 failed", summary prop, with an optional duration and progress bar) and opens into its suites. TestSuite (name, status) is a collapsible line with TestSuiteStats that opens when it has a failure; Test (name, status, duration) is a line with a passed, failed, skipped or running status, and a failed test opens into TestError, the failure message and stack in the code font. Without a summary the run reads as running.
